name: logseq-geml
description: GEML as a text serialization for Logseq DB graphs: as readable as their Markdown export, as lossless as their EDN export. core/ holds the converter and sync engine, watcher/ the CLI that keeps a Git-versioned folder in step, plugin/ the in-app half (Live Sync Vault). One install at this root covers all three — plugin/ is an npm workspace, core/ and watcher/ are plain directories whose dependencies live here.

scripts.test: node core/test/roundtrip.test.mjs && node core/test/sync.test.mjs && node watcher/test/cli-sync.test.mjs && node watcher/test/signal-sync.test.mjs && node plugin/test/core.test.mjs
